_: Hand-drawn text regions on real photographs. Boxes are [x0,y0,x1,y1] in the frame app/ocr.py:load_within_limits() hands to the detector — the photo after the 2 MP shrink — because that is the image the detector actually sees. Drawn by eye on a coordinate grid, never from a detector's output: a ground truth seeded by the model under test cannot measure that model's recall. scope: sign = signage, the text the product is pointed at; body = dense small print on an information board; incidental = text that happens to be in shot. text = null means a region a human can see is text but cannot transcribe, which counts for detection and is excluded from reading.
